title: Beyond State-of-the-Art: Standardising Environmental Impact Metrics for AI Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.01116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As the capabilities and ubiquity of Large Language Models (LLMs) grow, so does their environmental footprint. Despite calls for responsible AI, the machine learning community lacks standardised practices for carbon accounting. Our automated literature review of the 5,285 papers accepted to NeurIPS 2025 reveals that reporting of environmental impact is nearly non-existent. To catalyse a shift toward sustainable AI, we define standardised sustainability metrics for evaluating model training efficiency, accompanied by simple heuristics to estimate the carbon cost of LLM inference. We implement these metrics in carbonbenchmark, a drop-in software solution for tracking and reporting emissions. translated_title: 超越最先进水平：为AI研究标准化环境影响指标
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）能力的增强和普及，其环境足迹也在不断扩大。尽管业界呼吁负责任的AI，但机器学习社区一直缺乏标准化的碳核算实践。我们对NeurIPS 2025接收的5,285篇论文进行的自动化文献综述显示，环境影响的报告几乎不存在。为了推动AI向可持续方向转变，我们定义了用于评估模型训练效率的标准化可持续性指标，并配有估算LLM推理碳成本的简单启发式方法。我们在carbonbenchmark中实现了这些指标，这是一个用于跟踪和报告碳排放的即插即用软件解决方案。最后，为了对抗以不成比例的环境代价追求边际精度提升的做法，我们形式化了“完成工作所需的最小模型”（SMAJ）框架，该框架挑战整个领域将计算效率和环境[影响]置于优先地位。
tldr: 该论文针对机器学习社区缺乏标准化碳核算的问题，通过分析NeurIPS 2025的5285篇论文揭示环境影响报告几乎缺失的现状，并提出了标准化可持续性指标、carbonbenchmark碳排放跟踪工具以及“完成工作所需的最小模型”（SMAJ）框架，以推动可持续AI的发展。
en_tdlr: Addressing the near-total absence of environmental impact reporting in AI research, this paper proposes standardized sustainability metrics, the carbonbenchmark emissions tracking tool, and the 'Smallest Model that Achieves the Job' (SMAJ) framework to promote sustainable AI development.
